name: sky-rust-backend
description: In-repo marketplace for the Sky Rust-backend skill suite. Install with: claude plugin marketplace add <path-to-sky-repo>/runtime-rust/plugins

plugins.name: sky-rust-backend
plugins.description: Sky Rust-backend verification + maintenance suite: build/run/web/perf sweeps, keep-go-parity orchestrator, upstream sync, README update, FFI audit. Skills are namespaced sky-rust-backend:<name>; the underlying scripts live in runtime-rust/scripts/ and run standalone without an agent.
